decisions.reason: The updated authoritative file and restoration of missing content do not change the copyediting standards or the existing sentence-level editorial constraints.
The source decision does not mention or alter the requirement to exclude the unintended newline marker from the book title.
The source content-integrity change does not modify the image-rendering constraints; the separate image defects in the same message are already represented by the candidate's runtime event.
Selecting a newer manuscript file and restoring missing content does not resolve or modify the cover-design choices.
The source does not change the publication attribution line or otherwise address copyright-page attribution.
The authoritative manuscript-file change does not alter the requested publishing-process or prerequisite guidance.
The source content-integrity change does not modify the Chapter 18 heading hierarchy, punctuation, or capitalization requirements.
Paragraph spacing is an independent requirement introduced by another clause of the same message, not a necessary consequence of replacing the authoritative manuscript file.
Italic formatting for Mama's Hot Take is an independent requirement stated in another clause and is not changed by the content-integrity decision.
The source decision does not alter the permitted image source, suitability-review obligation, or suitability criteria.
Replacing the authoritative manuscript file does not change chapter-image coverage, placement, presentation, or image-reference rules.
The manuscript content-integrity change does not modify or resume the deferred KDP assistance workflow.
